summary: community.aws in 10.0.0 drops botocore<1.29.0 and boto3<1.26.0 (warning only), ansible-core below 2.15 and Python below 3.7. Modules aws_region_info, aws_s3_bucket_info, iam_access_key, iam_access_key_info and iam_group were migrated to amazon.aws, so FQCNs need updating.
questions: Which FQCN should I use for aws_region_info now?
What minimum boto3 version does community.aws need?

answer_card.title: community.aws migrations and SDK requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
- Minimum SDK: `botocore>=1.29.0`, `boto3>=1.26.0`. Older versions emit a warning and are untested.
- Requires ansible-core 2.15+ and Python 3.7+.
- Moved to amazon.aws, so update FQCNs: `amazon.aws.aws_region_info`, `amazon.aws.aws_s3_bucket_info`, `amazon.aws.iam_access_key`, `amazon.aws.iam_access_key_info`, `amazon.aws.iam_group`.
